NEEDED (S4e, contributor-friendly; sync-s3a9 summary): when `codex sandbox` runs with --sandbox-state-json, decide MXC only from the state's use_mxc (true: MXC plus exec::refuse_mxc_without_corbanu_protections; false: never MXC, and refuse to launch if the child's own config would pick it); add the test below. | S3a contract (sync-s3a8, #2160 review r1/r2, D541 (a) owner-accepted 2026-11-14): with --sandbox-state-json, the state's use_mxc decides in both directions. If true, use MXC and also run exec::refuse_mxc_without_corbanu_protections(WindowsMxc, the state's profile, launch_contract::active().is_some(), &[]) as defence in depth. If false, never use MXC: when the child's own config would choose it (windows.sandbox = mxc, prefer_mxc or require_mxc), fail closed instead of launching. Test: use_mxc false with the child configured for MXC is refused. With this, the parent's check (#2160: use_mxc only when its launch contract is not armed and the profile denies no reads) is complete.

Test contract (from #2146 review): includes main's realtime_webrtc_accounting_tests.rs, which still calls the removed run_webrtc_sideband_input_task with the old fields; port it to spawn_webrtc_sideband_input_task(input, record) (session_initialization, transcript_tail_flush, model_client) and check the record end is written exactly once (closing adds no second end; #1000 inactive sideband), with the end taken before the transport close; plus admission before a pending-outbound resend and each sideband (re)connection. | sync-compile2: conflict-free per test item (both sides' tests kept); the #2146 test contract (realtime_webrtc_accounting_tests port) is still open (#2263)

Also (#2147 review r2): a secret-named credential alias exported as a tied array is dropped from the file and restored as a placeholder scalar by the post-loop alias pass instead of upstream's invalid_export bail; cover it. | sync-compile2: upstream's tests with main's removed_env_vars argument; main's bash multiline and zsh tied-PATH tests dropped here because upstream moved them to shell-command/src/shell_snapshot_tests.rs (main's only change was the removed_env_vars script argument, which the sync capture applies at run time); the sync-s2a7 test contract is still open; upstream's clean deletion of the two strip_snapshot_preamble tests carried (#2263)
